note: Frozen snapshot of the ZetaOffice CDN `_latest` payload. `_latest` is a rolling alias (rebuilt over time, ~20 min cache) — relying on it makes boots non-reproducible and risks silent breakage. This manifest pins the EXACT bytes by sha256 so every build serves the same, verified runtime. Identified by build date (Last-Modified 2025-05-13 15:18 UTC); the upstream payload carries no extractable product-version string. NOTE: soffice.wasm and soffice.data are stored Brotli-compressed (bytes/sha256 below are of the compressed form). They MUST be served with `Content-Encoding: br` (handled by vite.config.ts in dev/preview; your production host must do the same).
